arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
transliteration: Haa-Meeem

translations.en.sahih: Ha, Meem.
translations.en.pickthall: Ha. Mim.
translations.en.yusufali: Ha-Mim
translations.id.indonesian: Haa Miim.

arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
transliteration: Wal Kitaabil Mubeen

translations.en.sahih: By the clear Book,
translations.en.pickthall: By the Scripture which maketh plain,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Book that makes things clear,-
translations.id.indonesian: Demi Kitab (Al Quran) yang menerangkan.

arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
transliteration: Innaa ja'alnaahu Quraanan 'Arabiyyal la'allakum ta'qiloon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.
translations.en.yusufali: We have made it a Qur'an in Arabic, that ye may be able to understand (and learn wisdom).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menjadikan Al Quran dalam bahasa Arab supaya kamu memahami(nya).

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
transliteration: Wa innahoo feee Ummil Kitaabi Ladainaa la'aliyyun hakeem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
translations.en.pickthall: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily, it is in the Mother of the Book, in Our Presence, high (in dignity), full of wisdom.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu dalam induk Al Kitab (Lauh Mahfuzh) di sisi Kami, adalah benar-benar tinggi (nilainya) dan amat banyak mengandung hikmah.

arabic: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ
transliteration: Afanadribu 'ankumuz Zikra safhan an kuntum qawmam musrifeen

translations.en.sahih: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
translations.en.pickthall: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk?
translations.en.yusufali: Shall We then take away the Message from you and repel (you), for that ye are a people transgressing beyond bounds?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah Kami akan berhenti menurunkan Al Quran kepadamu, karena kamu adalah kaum yang melampaui batas?

arabic: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّۢ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Wa kam arsalnaa min Nabiyyin fil awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
translations.en.pickthall: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old!
translations.en.yusufali: But how many were the prophets We sent amongst the peoples of old?
translations.id.indonesian: Berapa banyaknya nabi-nabi yang telah Kami utus kepada umat-umat yang terdahulu.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
transliteration: Wa maa yaateehim min Nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihee yasahzi'oon

translations.en.sahih: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
translations.en.pickthall: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.
translations.en.yusufali: And never came there a prophet to them but they mocked him.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tiada seorang nabipun datang kepada mereka melainkan mereka selalu memperolok-olokkannya.

arabic: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Fa ahlaknaaa ashadda minhum batshanw wa madaa masalul lawwaleen

translations.en.sahih: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).
translations.en.yusufali: So We destroyed (them)- stronger in power than these;- and (thus) has passed on the Parable of the peoples of old.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka telah Kami binasakan orang-orang yang lebih besar kekuatannya dari mereka itu (musyrikin Mekah) dan telah terdahulu (tersebut dalam Al Quran) perumpamaan umat-umat masa dahulu.

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal arda la yaqoolunna khalaqa hunnal 'Azeezul 'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
translations.en.pickthall: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;
translations.en.yusufali: If thou wert to question them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' They would be sure to reply, 'they were created by (Him), the Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge';-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sungguh jika kamu tanyakan kepada mereka: "Siapakah yang menciptakan langit dan bumi?", niscaya mereka akan menjawab: "Semuanya diciptakan oleh Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Mengetahui".

arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa ja'ala lakum feehaa subulal la'allakum tahtadoon

translations.en.sahih: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
translations.en.pickthall: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way;
translations.en.yusufali: (Yea, the same that) has made for you the earth (like a carpet) spread out, and has made for you roads (and channels) therein, in order that ye may find guidance (on the way);
translations.id.indonesian: Yang menjadikan bumi untuk kamu sebagai tempat menetap dan Dia membuat jalan-jalan di atas bumi untuk kamu supaya kamu mendapat petunjuk.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
transliteration: Wallazee nazzala minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa anshamaa bihee baldatam maitaa' kazaalika tukhrajoon

translations.en.sahih: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
translations.en.pickthall: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth;
translations.en.yusufali: That sends down (from time to time) rain from the sky in due measure;- and We raise to life therewith a land that is dead; even so will ye be raised (from the dead);-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Yang menurunkan air dari langit menurut kadar (yang diperlukan) lalu Kami hidupkan dengan air itu negeri yang mati, seperti itulah kamu akan dikeluarkan (dari dalam kubur).

arabic: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
transliteration: Wallazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa wa ja'ala lakum minal fulki wal-an'aami maa tarkaboon

translations.en.sahih: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
translations.en.pickthall: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.
translations.en.yusufali: That has created pairs in all things, and has made for you ships and cattle on which ye ride,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Yang menciptakan semua yang berpasang-pasangan dan menjadikan untukmu kapal dan binatang ternak yang kamu tunggangi.

arabic: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
transliteration: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee summa tazkuroo ni'mata Rabbikum izastawaitum 'alaihi wa taqooloo Subhaanal lazee sakhkhara lana haaza wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen

translations.en.sahih: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
translations.en.pickthall: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);
translations.en.yusufali: In order that ye may sit firm and square on their backs, and when so seated, ye may celebrate the (kind) favour of your Lord, and say, "Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves),
translations.id.indonesian: Supaya kamu duduk di atas punggungnya kemudian kamu ingat nikmat Tuhanmu apabila kamu telah duduk di atasnya; dan supaya kamu mengucapkan: "Maha Suci Tuhan yang telah menundukkan semua ini bagi kami padahal kami sebelumnya tidak mampu menguasainya,

arabic: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Wa innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.
translations.en.yusufali: "And to our Lord, surely, must we turn back!"
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya kami akan kembali kepada Tuhan kami".

arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Wa ja'aloo lahoo min 'ibaadihee juz'aa; innal insaana lakafoorum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
translations.en.pickthall: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.
translations.en.yusufali: Yet they attribute to some of His servants a share with Him (in his godhead)! truly is man a blasphemous ingrate avowed!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka menjadikan sebahagian dari hamba-hamba-Nya sebagai bahagian daripada-Nya. Sesungguhnya manusia itu benar-benar pengingkar yang nyata (terhadap rahmat Allah).

arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
transliteration: Amit takhaza mimmaa yakhluqu banaatinw wa asfaakum bilbaneen

translations.en.sahih: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
translations.en.pickthall: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons?
translations.en.yusufali: What! has He taken daughters out of what He himself creates, and granted to you sons for choice?
translations.id.indonesian: Patutkah Dia mengambil anak perempuan dari yang diciptakan-Nya dan Dia mengkhususkan buat kamu anak laki-laki.

arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
transliteration: Wa izaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir Rahmaani masalan zalla wajhuhoo muswaddanw wa hua kazeem

translations.en.sahih: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
translations.en.pickthall: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.
translations.en.yusufali: When news is brought to one of them of (the birth of) what he sets up as a likeness to (Allah) Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he is filled with inward grief!
translations.id.indonesian: Padahal apabila salah seorang di antara mereka diberi kabar gembira dengan apa yang dijadikan sebagai misal bagi Allah Yang Maha Pemurah; jadilah mukanya hitam pekat sedang dia amat menahan sedih.

arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ
transliteration: Awa mai yunashsha'u fil hilyati wa huwa fil khisaami ghairu mubeen

translations.en.sahih: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
translations.en.pickthall: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain?
translations.en.yusufali: Is then one brought up among trinkets, and unable to give a clear account in a dispute (to be associated with Allah)?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apakah patut (menjadi anak Allah) orang yang dibesarkan dalam keadaan berperhiasan sedang dia tidak dapat memberi alasan yang terang dalam pertengkaran.

arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
transliteration: Wa ja'alul malaaa'ikatal lazeena hum 'ibaadur Rahmaani inaasaa; a shahidoo khalaqhum; satuktabu shahaa datuhum wa yus'aloon

translations.en.sahih: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
translations.en.pickthall: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.
translations.en.yusufali: And they make into females angels who themselves serve Allah. Did they witness their creation? Their evidence will be recorded, and they will be called to account!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka menjadikan malaikat-malaikat yang mereka itu adalah hamba-hamba Allah Yang Maha Pemurah sebagai orang-orang perempuan. Apakah mereka menyaksikan penciptaan malaika-malaikat itu? Kelak akan dituliskan persaksian mereka dan mereka akan dimintai pertanggung-jawaban.

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
transliteration: Wa qaaloo law shaaa'ar Rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum; maa lahum bizaalika min 'ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon

translations.en.sahih: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.
translations.en.yusufali: ("Ah!") they say, "If it had been the will of (Allah) Most Gracious, we should not have worshipped such (deities)!" Of that they have no knowledge! they do nothing but lie!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Jikalau Allah Yang Maha Pemurah menghendaki tentulah kami tidak menyembah mereka (malaikat)". Mereka tidak mempunyai pengetahuan sedikitpun tentang itu, mereka tidak lain hanyalah menduga-duga belaka.

arabic: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
transliteration: Am aatainaahum Kitaabam min qablihee fahum bihee mustamsikoon

translations.en.sahih: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
translations.en.pickthall: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto?
translations.en.yusufali: What! have We given them a Book before this, to which they are holding fast?
translations.id.indonesian: Atau adakah Kami memberikan sebuah kitab kepada mereka sebelum Al Quran, lalu mereka berpegang dengan kitab itu?

arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Bal qaalooo innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw wa innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muhtadoon

translations.en.sahih: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay! they say: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we do guide ourselves by their footsteps."
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami mendapati bapak-bapak kami menganut suatu agama, dan sesungguhnya kami orang-orang yang mendapat petunjuk dengan (mengikuti) jejak mereka".

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Wa kazaalika maaa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatim min nazeerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaaa innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw wa innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muqtadoon

translations.en.sahih: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
translations.en.pickthall: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.
translations.en.yusufali: Just in the same way, whenever We sent a Warner before thee to any people, the wealthy ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we will certainly follow in their footsteps."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan demikianlah, Kami tidak mengutus sebelum kamu seorang pemberi peringatanpun dalam suatu negeri, melainkan orang-orang yang hidup mewah di negeri itu berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami mendapati bapak-bapak kami menganut suatu agama dan sesungguhnya kami adalah pengikut jejak-jejak mereka".

arabic: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
transliteration: Qaala awa law ji'tukum bi ahdaa mimmaa wajattum 'alaihi aabaaa'akum qaalooo innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon

translations.en.sahih: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
translations.en.pickthall: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "What! Even if I brought you better guidance than that which ye found your fathers following?" They said: "For us, we deny that ye (prophets) are sent (on a mission at all)."
translations.id.indonesian: (Rasul itu) berkata: "Apakah (kamu akan mengikutinya juga) sekalipun aku membawa untukmu (agama) yang lebih (nyata) memberi petunjuk daripada apa yang kamu dapati bapak-bapakmu menganutnya?" Mereka menjawab: "Sesungguhnya kami mengingkari agama yang kamu diutus untuk menyampaikannya".

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen

translations.en.sahih: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!
translations.en.yusufali: So We exacted retribution from them: now see what was the end of those who rejected (Truth)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami binasakan mereka maka perhatikanlah bagaimana kesudahan orang-orang yang mendustakan itu.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
transliteration: Wa iz qaala Ibraaheemu liabeehi wa qawmiheee innane baraaa'um mimmaa ta'budo

translations.en.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
translations.en.pickthall: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! Abraham said to his father and his people: "I do indeed clear myself of what ye worship:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ingatlah ketika Ibrahim berkata kepada bapaknya dan kaumnya: "Sesungguhnya aku tidak bertanggung jawab terhadap apa yang kamu sembah,

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
transliteration: Illal lazee fataranee innahoo sa yahdeen

translations.en.sahih: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
translations.en.pickthall: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.
translations.en.yusufali: "(I worship) only Him Who made me, and He will certainly guide me."
translations.id.indonesian: tetapi (aku menyembah) Tuhan Yang menjadikanku; karena sesungguhnya Dia akan memberi hidayah kepadaku".

arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
transliteration: Wa ja'alahaa Kalimatam baaqiyatan fee 'aqibihee la'al lahum yarji'oon

translations.en.sahih: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
translations.en.pickthall: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.
translations.en.yusufali: And he left it as a Word to endure among those who came after him, that they may turn back (to Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (lbrahim a. s.) menjadikan kalimat tauhid itu kalimat yang kekal pada keturunannya supaya mereka kembali kepada kalimat tauhid itu.

arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Bal matta'tu haaa'ulaaa'i wa aabaaa'ahum hattaa jaaa'a humul haqqu wa Rasoolum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.
translations.en.yusufali: Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and a messenger making things clear.
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi Aku telah memberikan kenikmatan hidup kepada mereka dan bapak-bapak mereka sehingga datanglah kepada mereka kebenaran (Al Quran) dan seorang rasul yang memberi penjelasan.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa lammaa jaaa'ahumul haqqu qaaloo haazaa sihrunw wa innaa bihee kaafiroon

translations.en.sahih: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
translations.en.pickthall: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.
translations.en.yusufali: But when the Truth came to them, they said: "This is sorcery, and we do reject it."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tatkala kebenaran (Al Quran) itu datang kepada mereka, mereka berkata: "Ini adalah sihir dan sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang mengingkarinya".

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa qaaloo law laa nuzzila haazal Quraanu 'alaa rajulim minal qaryataini 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?
translations.en.yusufali: Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Mengapa Al Quran ini tidak diturunkan kepada seorang besar dari salah satu dua negeri (Mekah dan Thaif) ini?"

arabic: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
transliteration: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata Rabbik; Nahnu qasamnaa bainahum ma'eeshatahum fil hayaatid dunyaa wa rafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajaatil liyattakhiza ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyaa; wa rahmatu Rabbika khairum mimmaa yajma'oon

translations.en.sahih: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
translations.en.pickthall: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.
translations.en.yusufali: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass.
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka yang membagi-bagi rahmat Tuhanmu? Kami telah menentukan antara mereka penghidupan mereka dalam kehidupan dunia, dan kami telah meninggikan sebahagian mereka atas sebagian yang lain beberapa derajat, agar sebagian mereka dapat mempergunakan sebagian yang lain. Dan rahmat Tuhanmu lebih baik dari apa yang mereka kumpulkan.

arabic: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
transliteration: Wa law laaa any yakoonan naasu ummatanw waahidatal laja'alnaa limany yakfuru bir Rahmaani libu yootihim suqufam min fiddatinw wa ma'aarija 'alaihaa yazharoon

translations.en.sahih: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
translations.en.pickthall: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,
translations.en.yusufali: And were it not that (all) men might become of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, for everyone that blasphemes against (Allah) Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stair-ways on which to go up,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sekiranya bukan karena hendak menghindari manusia menjadi umat yang satu (dalam kekafiran), tentulah kami buatkan bagi orang-orang yang kafir kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah loteng-loteng perak bagi rumah mereka dan (juga) tangga-tangga (perak) yang mereka menaikinya.

arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
transliteration: Wa libu yootihim abwaabanw wa sururan 'alaihaa yattaki'oon

translations.en.sahih: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
translations.en.pickthall: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,
translations.en.yusufali: And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (Kami buatkan pula) pintu-pintu (perak) bagi rumah-rumah mereka dan (begitu pula) dipan-dipan yang mereka bertelekan atasnya.

arabic: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
transliteration: Wa zukhrufaa; wa in kullu zaalika lammaa mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa; wal aakhiratu 'inda Rabbika lilmuttaqeen

translations.en.sahih: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.
translations.en.yusufali: And also adornments of gold. But all this were nothing but conveniences of the present life: The Hereafter, in the sight of thy Lord is for the Righteous.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (Kami buatkan pula) perhiasan-perhiasan (dari emas untuk mereka). Dan semuanya itu tidak lain hanyalah kesenangan kehidupan dunia, dan kehidupan akhirat itu di sisi Tuhanmu adalah bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.

arabic: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًۭا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌۭ
transliteration: Wa mai ya'shu 'an zikrir Rahmaani nuqaiyid lahoo Shaitaanan fahuwa lahoo qareen

translations.en.sahih: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
translations.en.pickthall: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;
translations.en.yusufali: If anyone withdraws himself from remembrance of (Allah) Most Gracious, We appoint for him an evil one, to be an intimate companion to him.
translations.id.indonesian: Barangsiapa yang berpaling dari pengajaran Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah (Al Quran), kami adakan baginya syaitan (yang menyesatkan) maka syaitan itulah yang menjadi teman yang selalu menyertainya.

arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Wa innahum la yasuddoo nahum 'anis sabeeli wa yahsaboona annahum muhtadoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;
translations.en.yusufali: Such (evil ones) really hinder them from the Path, but they think that they are being guided aright!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya syaitan-syaitan itu benar-benar menghalangi mereka dari jalan yang benar dan mereka menyangka bahwa mereka mendapat petunjuk.

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
transliteration: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'anaa qaala yaa laita bainee wa bainaka bu'dal mashriqaini fabi'sal qareen

translations.en.sahih: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
translations.en.pickthall: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!
translations.en.yusufali: At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)!
translations.id.indonesian: Sehingga apabila orang-orang yang berpaling itu datang kepada kami (di hari kiamat) dia berkata: "Aduhai, semoga (jarak) antaraku dan kamu seperti jarak antara masyrik dan maghrib, maka syaitan itu adalah sejahat-jahat teman (yang menyertai manusia)".

arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
transliteration: Wa lai yanfa'akumul Yawma iz zalamtum annakum fil 'azaabi mushtarikoon

translations.en.sahih: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.
translations.en.yusufali: When ye have done wrong, it will avail you nothing, that Day, that ye shall be partners in Punishment!
translations.id.indonesian: (Harapanmu itu) sekali-kali tidak akan memberi manfaat kepadamu di hari itu karena kamu telah menganiaya (dirimu sendiri). Sesungguhnya kamu bersekutu dalam azab itu.

arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
transliteration: Afa anta tusmi'us summa aw tahdil 'umya wa man kaana fee dalaalim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
translations.en.pickthall: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?
translations.en.yusufali: Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or give direction to the blind or to such as (wander) in manifest error?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kamu dapat menjadikan orang yang pekak bisa mendengar atau (dapatkah) kamu memberi petunjuk kepada orang yang buta (hatinya) dan kepada orang yang tetap dalam kesesatan yang nyata?

arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
transliteration: Fa immaa nazhabanna bika fa innaa minhum muntaqimoon

translations.en.sahih: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
translations.en.pickthall: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,
translations.en.yusufali: Even if We take thee away, We shall be sure to exact retribution from them,
translations.id.indonesian: Sungguh, jika Kami mewafatkan kamu (sebelum kamu mencapai kemenangan) maka sesungguhnya Kami akan menyiksa mereka (di akhirat).

arabic: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
transliteration: Aw nuriyannakal lazee wa'adnaahum fa innaa 'alaihim muqtadiroon

translations.en.sahih: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
translations.en.pickthall: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.
translations.en.yusufali: Or We shall show thee that (accomplished) which We have promised them: for verily We shall prevail over them.
translations.id.indonesian: Atau Kami memperlihatkan kepadamu (azab) yang telah Kami ancamkan kepada mereka. Maka sesungguhnya Kami berkuasa atas mereka.

arabic: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Fastamsik billazeee oohi ya ilaika innaka 'alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
translations.en.pickthall: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.
translations.en.yusufali: So hold thou fast to the Revelation sent down to thee; verily thou art on a Straight Way.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berpegang teguhlah kamu kepada agama yang telah diwahyukan kepadamu. Sesungguhnya kamu berada di atas jalan yang lurus.

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌۭ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
transliteration: Wa innahoo lazikrul laka wa liqawmika wa sawfa tus'aloon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.
translations.en.yusufali: The (Qur'an) is indeed the message, for thee and for thy people; and soon shall ye (all) be brought to account.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar adalah suatu kemuliaan besar bagimu dan bagi kaummu dan kelak kamu akan diminta pertanggungan jawab.

arabic: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ
transliteration: Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika mir Rusulinaaa aja'alnaa min doonir Rahmaani aalihatany yu badoon

translations.en.sahih: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
translations.en.pickthall: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent?
translations.en.yusufali: And question thou our messengers whom We sent before thee; did We appoint any deities other than (Allah) Most Gracious, to be worshipped?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tanyakanlah kepada rasul-rasul Kami yang telah Kami utus sebelum kamu: "Adakah Kami menentukan tuhan-tuhan untuk disembah selain Allah Yang Maha Pemurah?"

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi aayaatinaaa ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee faqaala innee Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.en.yusufali: We did send Moses aforetime, with Our Signs, to Pharaoh and his Chiefs: He said, "I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesunguhnya Kami telah mengutus Musa dengan membawa mukjizat-mukjizat Kami kepada Fir'aun dan pemuka-pemuka kaumnya. Maka Musa berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku adalah utusan dari Tuhan seru sekalian alam".

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
transliteration: Falammma jaaa'ahum bi aayaatinaaa izaa hum minhaa yadhakoon

translations.en.sahih: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
translations.en.pickthall: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.
translations.en.yusufali: But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tatkala dia datang kepada mereka dengan membawa mukjizat-mukjizat Kami dengan serta merta mereka mentertawakannya.

arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
transliteration: Wa maa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa wa akhaznaahum bil'azaabi la'allahum yarji'oon

translations.en.sahih: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
translations.en.pickthall: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.
translations.en.yusufali: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah Kami perlihatkan kepada mereka sesuatu mukjizat kecuali mukjizat itu lebih besar dari mukjizat-mukjizat yang sebelumnya. Dan Kami timpakan kepada mereka azab supaya mereka kembali (ke jalan yang benar).

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Wa qaaloo yaaa ayyuhas saahirud'u lanaa Rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka innanaa lamuhtadoon

translations.en.sahih: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
translations.en.pickthall: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
translations.en.yusufali: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Hai ahli sihir, berdoalah kepada Tuhanmu untuk (melepaskan) kami sesuai dengan apa yang telah dijanjikan-Nya kepadamu; sesungguhnya kami (jika doamu dikabulkan) benar-benar akan menjadi orang yang mendapat petunjuk.

arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
transliteration: Falammaa kashafnaa 'anhumul 'azaaba izaa hum yankusoon

translations.en.sahih: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
translations.en.pickthall: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.
translations.en.yusufali: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tatkala Kami hilangkan azab itu dari mereka, dengan serta merta mereka memungkiri (janjinya).

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa naadaa Fir'awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaa qawmi alaisa lee mulku Misra wa haazihil anhaaru tajree min tahtee afalaa tubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
translations.en.pickthall: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?
translations.en.yusufali: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Fir'aun berseru kepada kaumnya (seraya) berkata: "Hai kaumku, bukankah kerajaan Mesir ini kepunyaanku dan (bukankah) sungai-sungai ini mengalir di bawahku; maka apakah kamu tidak melihat(nya)?

arabic: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌۭ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
transliteration: Am ana khairum min haazal lazee huwa maheenunw wa laa yuakaadu yubeen

translations.en.sahih: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
translations.en.pickthall: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!
translations.en.yusufali: "Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly?
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah aku lebih baik dari orang yang hina ini dan yang hampir tidak dapat menjelaskan (perkataannya)?

arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌۭ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
transliteration: Falaw laa ulqiya 'alaihi aswiratum min zahabin awjaaa'a ma'ahul malaaa'ikatu muqtarineen

translations.en.sahih: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
translations.en.pickthall: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?
translations.en.yusufali: "Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa tidak dipakaikan kepadanya gelang dari emas atau malaikat datang bersama-sama dia untuk mengiringkannya?"

arabic: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
transliteration: Fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa ataa'ooh; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen

translations.en.sahih: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Fir'aun mempengaruhi kaumnya (dengan perkataan itu) lalu mereka patuh kepadanya. Karena sesungguhnya mereka adalah kaum yang fasik.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Falammaaa aasafoonan taqamnaa minhum fa aghraqnaahum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
translations.en.pickthall: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.
translations.en.yusufali: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tatkala mereka membuat Kami murka, Kami menghukum mereka lalu kami tenggelamkan mereka semuanya (di laut),

arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًۭا وَمَثَلًۭا لِّلْءَاخِرِينَ
transliteration: Faja'alnaahum salafanw wa masalal lil aakhireen

translations.en.sahih: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
translations.en.pickthall: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).
translations.en.yusufali: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan mereka sebagai pelajaran dan contoh bagi orang-orang yang kemudian.

arabic: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
transliteration: Wa lammaa duribab nu Maryama masalan izaa qawmu ka minhu yasidoon

translations.en.sahih: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
translations.en.pickthall: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,
translations.en.yusufali: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tatkala putra Maryam (Isa) dijadikan perumpamnaan tiba-tiba kaummu (Quraisy) bersorak karenanya.

arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
transliteration: Wa qaalooo 'a-aalihatunaa khairun am hoo; maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa; balhum qawmun khasimoon

translations.en.sahih: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
translations.en.pickthall: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.
translations.en.yusufali: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Manakah yang lebih baik tuhan-tuhan kami atau dia (Isa)?" Mereka tidak memberikan perumpamaan itu kepadamu melainkan dengan maksud membantah saja, sebenarnya mereka adalah kaum yang suka bertengkar.

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
transliteration: In huwa illaa 'abdun an'amnaa 'alaihi wa ja'alnaahu masalal li Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.en.sahih: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
translations.en.pickthall: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.
translations.en.yusufali: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel.
translations.id.indonesian: Isa tidak lain hanyalah seorang hamba yang Kami berikan kepadanya nikmat (kenabian) dan Kami jadikan dia sebagai tanda bukti (kekuasaan Allah) untuk Bani lsrail

arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaaa'ikatan fil ardi yakhlufoon

translations.en.sahih: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
translations.en.pickthall: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.
translations.en.yusufali: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kalau Kami kehendaki benar-benar Kami jadikan sebagai gantimu di muka bumi malaikat-malaikat yang turun temurun.

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Wa innahoo la'ilmul lis Saa'ati fala tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oon; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.
translations.en.yusufali: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Isa itu benar-benar memberikan pengetahuan tentang hari kiamat. Karena itu janganlah kamu ragu-ragu tentang kiamat itu dan ikutilah Aku. Inilah jalan yang lurus.

arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Wa laa yasuddan nakumush Shaitaanu innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
translations.en.pickthall: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
translations.en.yusufali: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan janganlah kamu sekali-kali dipalingkan oleh syaitan; sesungguhnya syaitan itu musuh yang nyata bagimu.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
transliteration: Wa lammaa jaaa'a 'Eesaa bilbaiyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil Hikmati wa li-ubaiyina lakum ba'dal lazee takhtalifoona feehi fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.en.sahih: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.pickthall: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
translations.en.yusufali: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear Allah and obey me.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tatkala Isa datang membawa keterangan dia berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku datang kepadamu dengan membawa hikmat dan untuk menjelaskan kepadamu sebagian dari apa yang kamu berselisih tentangnya, maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah (kepada)ku".

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Innal laaha Huwa Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haaza Siraatum Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
translations.en.yusufali: "For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Allah Dialah Tuhanku dan Tuhan kamu maka sembahlah Dia, ini adalah jalan yang lurus.

arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
transliteration: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena zalamoo min 'azaabi Yawmin aleem

translations.en.sahih: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
translations.en.pickthall: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.
translations.en.yusufali: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berselisihlah golongan-golongan (yang terdapat) di antara mereka, lalu kecelakaan yang besarlah bagi orang-orang yang zalim yakni siksaan hari yang pedih (kiamat).

arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
transliteration: Hal yanzuroona illas Saa'ata an taatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

translations.en.sahih: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
translations.en.pickthall: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?
translations.en.yusufali: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak menunggu kecuali kedatangan hari kiamat kepada mereka dengan tiba-tiba sedang mereka tidak menyadarinya.

arabic: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
transliteration: Al akhillaaa'u Yawma'izim ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illal muttaqeen

translations.en.sahih: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
translations.en.pickthall: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).
translations.en.yusufali: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
translations.id.indonesian: Teman-teman akrab pada hari itu sebagiannya menjadi musuh bagi sebagian yang lain kecuali orang-orang yang bertakwa.

arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
transliteration: Yaa 'ibaadi laa khawfun 'alaikumul Yawma wa laaa antum tahzanoon

translations.en.sahih: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
translations.en.pickthall: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
translations.en.yusufali: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
translations.id.indonesian: "Hai hamba-hamba-Ku, tiada kekhawatiran terhadapmu pada hari ini dan tidak pula kamu bersedih hati.

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Allazeena aamanoo bi Aayaatinaa wa kaanoo muslimeen

translations.en.sahih: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
translations.en.pickthall: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,
translations.en.yusufali: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) orang-orang yang beriman kepada ayat-ayat Kami dan adalah mereka dahulu orang-orang yang berserah diri.

arabic: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
transliteration: Udkhulul Jannata antum wa azwaajukum tuhbaroon

translations.en.sahih: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
translations.en.pickthall: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
translations.en.yusufali: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
translations.id.indonesian: Masuklah kamu ke dalam surga, kamu dan isteri-isteri kamu digembirakan".

arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
transliteration: Yutaafu 'alaihim bishaa fim min zahabinw wa akwaab, wa feehaa maatashtaheehil anfusu wa talazzul a'yunu wa antum feehaa khaalidoon

translations.en.sahih: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
translations.en.pickthall: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
translations.en.yusufali: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
translations.id.indonesian: Diedarkan kepada mereka piring-piring dari emas, dan piala-piala dan di dalam surga itu terdapat segala apa yang diingini oleh hati dan sedap (dipandang) mata dan kamu kekal di dalamnya".

arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Wa tilkal jannatul lateee ooristumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
translations.en.pickthall: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
translations.en.yusufali: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan itulah surga yang diwariskan kepada kamu disebabkan amal-amal yang dahulu kamu kerjakan.

arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
transliteration: Lakum feehaa faakihatun kaseeratum minhaa taakuloon

translations.en.sahih: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
translations.en.pickthall: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
translations.en.yusufali: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam surga itu ada buah-buahan yang banyak untukmu yang sebahagiannya kamu makan.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
transliteration: Innal mujrimeena fee 'azaabi jahannama khaalidoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.
translations.en.yusufali: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berdosa kekal di dalam azab neraka Jahannam.

arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
transliteration: Laa yufattaru 'anhum wa hum feehi mublisoon

translations.en.sahih: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
translations.en.pickthall: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
translations.en.yusufali: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak diringankan azab itu dari mereka dan mereka di dalamnya berputus asa.

arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin kaanoo humuz zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
translations.en.pickthall: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.
translations.en.yusufali: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah Kami menganiaya mereka tetapi merekalah yang menganiaya diri mereka sendiri.

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
transliteration: Wa naadaw yaa Maaliku liyaqdi 'alainaa Rabbuka qaala innakum maakisson

translations.en.sahih: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
translations.en.pickthall: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
translations.en.yusufali: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berseru: "Hai Malik biarlah Tuhanmu membunuh kami saja". Dia menjawab: "Kamu akan tetap tinggal (di neraka ini)".

arabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
transliteration: Laqad ji'naakum bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarakum lilhaqqi kaarihoon

translations.en.sahih: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
translations.en.pickthall: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar telah memhawa kebenaran kepada kamu tetapi kebanyakan di antara kamu benci pada kebenaran itu.

arabic: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
transliteration: Am abramooo amran fainnaa mubrimoon

translations.en.sahih: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
translations.en.pickthall: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.
translations.en.yusufali: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan mereka telah menetapkan satu tipu daya (jahat), maka sesungguhnya Kami menetapkan pula.

arabic: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
transliteration: Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wa najwaahum; balaa wa Rusulunaa ladaihim yaktuboon

translations.en.sahih: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
translations.en.pickthall: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.
translations.en.yusufali: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka mengira, bahwa Kami tidak mendengar rahasia dan bisikan-bisikan mereka? Sebenarnya (Kami mendengar), dan utusan-utusan (malaikat-malaikat) Kami selalu mencatat di sisi mereka.

arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ
transliteration: Qul in kaana lir Rahmaani walad; fa-ana awwalul 'aabideen

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
translations.en.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah, jika benar Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah mempunyai anak, maka akulah (Muhammad) orang yang mula-mula memuliakan (anak itu).

arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
transliteration: Subhaana Rabbis samaawaati wal ardi Rabbil Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
translations.en.pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
translations.en.yusufali: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maha Suci Tuhan Yang empunya langit dan bumi, Tuhan Yang empunya 'Arsy, dari apa yang mereka sifatkan itu.

arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo Yawmahumul lazee yoo'adoon

translations.en.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
translations.en.pickthall: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
translations.en.yusufali: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka biarlah mereka tenggelam (dalam kesesatan) dan bermain-main sampai mereka menemui hari yang dijanjikan kepada mereka.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee fissamaaa'i Ilaahunw wa fil ardi Ilaah; wa Huwal Hakeemul'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.
translations.en.yusufali: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dialah Tuhan (Yang disembah) di langit dan Tuhan (Yang disembah) di bumi dan Dialah Yang Maha Bijaksana lagi Maha Mengetahui.

arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
transliteration: Wa tabaarakal lazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa 'indahoo 'ilmus Saa'ati wa ilaihi turja'oon

translations.en.sahih: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
translations.en.pickthall: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
translations.en.yusufali: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Maha Suci Tuhan Yang mempunyai kerajaan langit dan bumi; dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya; dan di sisi-Nya-lah pengetahuan tentang hari kiamat dan hanya kepada-Nya-lah kamu dikembalikan.

arabic: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa laa yamlikul lazeena yad'oona min doonihish shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bilhaqqi wa hum ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
translations.en.pickthall: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.
translations.en.yusufali: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sembahan-sembahan yang mereka sembah selain Allah tidak dapat memberi syafa'at; akan tetapi (orang yang dapat memberi syafa'at ialah) orang yang mengakui yang hak (tauhid) dan mereka meyakini(nya).

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
transliteration: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqahum la yaqoolun nallaahu fa annaa yu'fakoon

translations.en.sahih: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
translations.en.pickthall: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
translations.en.yusufali: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sungguh jika kamu bertanya kepada mereka: "Siapakah yang menciptakan mereka, niscaya mereka menjawab: "Allah", maka bagaimanakah mereka dapat dipalingkan (dari menyembah Allah)?,

arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Wa qeelihee yaa Rabbi inna haa'ulaaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
translations.en.pickthall: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
translations.id.indonesian: dan (Allah mengetabui) ucapan Muhammad: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya mereka itu adalah kaum yang tidak beriman".

arabic: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Fasfah 'anhum wa qul salaam; fasawfa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
translations.en.yusufali: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berpalinglah (hai Muhammad) dari mereka dan katakanlah: "Salam (selamat tinggal)". Kelak mereka akan mengetahui (nasib mereka yang buruk).
